verdict: Strong revenue this period, but cost per purchase is 4x category norm — fix checkout friction before holiday peak.
diagnosis: Spent $6,820 generating $33,792 in purchases this period, but cost per purchase of $182 runs roughly 4x the food category benchmark.

signals.headline: Cost per purchase hit $182 this period
signals.detail: Roughly 4x the $38.57 food and beverage benchmark on Meta. The Premium Box awareness ad is driving traffic but not closing sales efficiently.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend reached 4.9x
signals.detail: $33,792 in purchases on $6,820 spend. Strong on paper and above the 1.61 category median, but driven by a $257 average order value.

signals.headline: 759 add-to-carts, only 284 checkouts
signals.detail: A 63% drop between cart and checkout points to friction at shipping, payment, or account creation. Biggest single lever to improve.

signals.headline: 1,901 new Instagram follows this period
signals.detail: Organic growth is healthy on a 13,369 follower base. Reels content including the butcher-wrapped lamb post is landing with the audience.

signals.headline: 278 reviews added at 5-star latest rating
signals.detail: Google Business Profile reputation is a tailwind. Worth surfacing in paid creative to reduce the trust barrier meat buyers face.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Meat category cost per purchase runs $38
benchmark.body: <cite index="12-8">Food and beverage ecommerce brands on Meta hit a median $38.57 cost per purchase at a 1.61 return on ad spend</cite>. Billy Doe sits at $182 cost per purchase this period — far above category norm.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: November drives peak fresh meat demand
seasonal.body: <cite index="20-4,20-5,20-6">November generated $9.2 billion in meat department sales last year, with pound sales up 2.9% driven by fresh meat up 4.1%</cite>. Holiday weeks ahead are the strongest buying window.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: <cite index="19-20">ButcherBox sells a replenishment meat subscription at $129–$149 monthly</cite>. <cite index="23-10">36% of consumers now buy through repeat or subscription models</cite>. Billy Doe's premium box concept fits this demand.

recommendations.title: Shift budget toward holiday Reels before Thanksgiving
recommendations.detail: Fresh meat demand peaks in the next three weeks. Consider concentrating spend on the Premium Box ad during pre-holiday windows when buying intent is highest.

recommendations.title: Test a subscription offer against one-time box
recommendations.detail: Replenishment models dominate the category. Worth testing a subscription angle on the Premium Box creative to lift repeat value and offset the current $182 cost per purchase.

recommendations.title: Fix the gap between add-to-cart and purchase
recommendations.detail: 759 add-to-carts produced 682 purchases but only 284 checkouts started. Worth auditing the checkout flow — shipping cost or account creation likely blocking conversions.
